nisha: quick note  ran int4-v5 canary on long-doc route at 2% (2h). p95 latency -120ms, cost/tokens -22%, long-doc MRR -2.4% (p=0.03). hallucination +0.1pp. proposing pause ramp, start 24h shadow and collect 500k-token traces. cc @paul @diego

paul: ouch on MRR, that's outside our usual tolerance. agree pause. can we lower next step to 1% and require 2 stable windows before any further ramp? add rolling median smoothing (w=3) on MRR.

diego: agree. also recommend anchor-set check for long-doc paraphrase prompts and a KL token-dist check. if anchor-concordance drops >=1.5% AND KL>0.1 -> auto rollback. otherwise shadow.

nisha: drafting small gate config: ```
warmstart: [1,2]
window_hours: 2
stability_windows_required: 2
fallback_rules: mrr_down_pct:1.5, p95_latency_ms:150, hallucination_pp:0.5
slice_shadow: 24h, collect_traces:500k
```

canary-bot: smoke summary for 5412378000: long-doc MRR -2.4% (p=0.03), p95 -120ms, cost -22%. fallback NOT triggered by rules (mrr threshold 1.5% but combined conditions not met). scheduled: 24h shadow and trace capture. link: https://ci.redwood-inference/smoke/5412378000

paul: good. action items: (1) start 24h shadow @2% for long-docs, (2) reduce next ramp to 1% until two stable windows, (3) run anchor/KL checks nightly, (4) alert if slice MRR delta >=1% for 30m.

diego: add +/-10% jitter to promotion timing to avoid region sync.

nisha: will push changes and update thread when shadow report is in.
